description: This file contains shell script functions related to Linux platform upgrade processes, including image validation, partition handling, bootloader upgrade, and overall upgrade procedures for x86-based Linux systems.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Validates the disk image by checking its magic word, extracting and comparing partition tables to determine if a full image write is necessary.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration data to the appropriate mounted partition (typically partition 1).

methods.name: platform_do_bootloader_upgrade
methods.description: Upgrades the system's bootloader using grub-bios-setup, mounting the boot partition temporarily and writing configuration.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the overall upgrade process, managing partition image writing, UUID updates, and invoking bootloader upgrade.
